coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole calculation/workbook owner. Read all five JSON files; for each symbol calculate daily simple percentage returns for the `Daily Returns` sheet and daily log returns for annualized volatility (`sample standard deviation * sqrt(252) * 100`), maximum drawdown as the largest positive peak-to-trough percentage, and first-to-last one-year return. Apply the portal threshold boundaries to maximum drawdown and compare volatility to the exact sector benchmark. Create `stock_volatility_report.xlsx` once with exact `Risk Analysis`, all five complete `Daily Returns` series sorted Symbol then Date, and `Summary`. Write literals only. The Summary must contain each exact requested label exactly once, including `Highest_Volatility_Stock`, with a nonblank ticker value. Read all three sheets back and explicitly return all six Summary label/value pairs, five source-vs-sheet row counts, the first/last two daily returns per symbol, and metric/category checks.
